contentText:
Ahead of Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve, we caught up with HUNTR/X in KPop Demon Hunters – EJAE (singing voice for RUMI), REI AMI (singing voice for ZOEY) and AUDREY NUNA (singing voice for Mira) – Demi Lovato, Charlie Puth, Zara Larsson, Jermaine Dupri and so many more. We find out what they want to leave behind in 2025, what they’re performing at Dick Clark’s New Year’s Rockin’ Eve, their pinch me moment of the year and more!

EJAE:

This whole year was a pinch me year. 

Ryan Tedder:

We were all literally, literally, like, is this real? What? What is happening? 

Zara Larsson:

It really has been an insane year for me.

Jermaine Dupri:

Something I want to leave in 2025? Oh, this is a good one.

EJAE:

We’re gonna be performing “Golden,” of course, from KPop Demon Hunters.

BigXthaPlug:

I will be performing one of the biggest country songs out right now, “All The Way,” featuring Bailey Zimmerman and the biggest, the largest, it’s just me.

Zara Larsson:

I will be performing “Midnight Sun” and a little snippet of “Lush Life” for New Year’s Eve. 

Jordan Davis:

At New Year’s Rockin’ Eve , I will be performing “Bar None and “I Ain’t Sayin'”

Charlie Puth:

I’m gonna be performing my new single, “Changes,” which is the first single on my album due in March. It’s called Whatever’s Clever . We’re gonna play “We Don’t Talk Anymore” because who doesn’t want to hear a sad song at the happiest time ever and “See You Again.” A slightly different arrangement. I got wonderful singers on stage with me, and we’re gonna harmonize it in a way that I don’t think anyone’s heard before.

Robby Takac:

Brand new single called “Not Goodbye.” We’re also doing the ever popular “Iris.”

Russell Dickerson:

I’m gonna be performing my song called “Happen To Me.” 

Tucker Wetmore:

For New Year’s Rockin’ Eve , I will be performing two of my songs “Wind Up Missing You” and “Brunette.”

Rick Springfield:

Favorite New Year’s Eve experience was…
Demi Lovato:

Some of my favorite New Year’s Eve memories would have to be when I was little, when the clock would strike midnight we would run up and down the streets, banging pots and pans, screaming “Happy New Year” and it’s one of the only nights of the year that you can do that as a kid.

BigXthaPlug:

Countdown the last 10 seconds. If you got a woman next to you get to kiss her. If you got some liquor next to you get to drink. It’s definitely that moment, that last 10 seconds, that’s the best time.

Charlie Puth:

Probably being on New Year’s Rockin’ Eve. I feel like that was my answer for the past few but it’s just so exciting here. There’s free drinks everywhere.

Keep watching for more!
